pt-br.name: Inspetor de URL
pt-br.title: Inspetor de URL: parâmetros, UTM e gclid, fbclid, ttclid
pt-br.description: Cole uma URL e veja cada parâmetro. Aponta UTM duplicada, conflitante, em maiúscula ou com espaço e identifica gclid, fbclid, ttclid e msclkid. Roda no navegador.

en.name: URL inspector
en.title: URL inspector: parameters, UTM and gclid, fbclid, ttclid
en.description: Paste a URL and see every parameter. Flags duplicate, conflicting, uppercase or spaced UTMs and identifies gclid, fbclid, ttclid and msclkid. Runs in your browser.
en.summary: Paste any campaign link and see its parameters, UTM mistakes and each platform's click identifiers.
